analyst.summary: CRISIL is India's leading credit-rating and research group, majority-owned by S&P Global, operating in an effectively 3-player domestic ratings oligopoly. Return on equity (~27%) and return on capital (~33%) are excellent, revenue has grown a consistent 12-18% across recent periods, and the group pays out over half its profit as dividends. At roughly 36 times earnings, the stock is fully priced for this quality but not obviously expensive relative to it. Our internal quantitative data for this name has significant coverage gaps, which we believe explains the Sell signal more than the underlying business quality. We rate this a Hold and are separately flagging the data-coverage gap for review.
